title: Gold Bar Reload Mint Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2 x Pods
description: Gold Bar Reload Mint Prefilled Pods deliver a crisp, cooling Mint flavour that’s sharp, smooth and unmistakably fresh. It’s a no-frills flavour designed to deliver clarity and consistency in every puff—ideal for vapers who enjoy a clean, refreshing profile without added sweetness or fruit elements. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is fitted with a mesh coil to deliver clear flavour and consistent vapour production. Designed for use with the Gold Bar Reload Pod Kit, these pods are inhale-activated and require no refilling or maintenance. Simple, clean and satisfying, Mint is a dependable choice for those who prefer slightly sweeter menthol-style flavours in an easy-to-use format.
